title: Redshirts
author: John Scalzi
summary: Ensign Andrew Dahl joins the flagship of a space fleet and notices that junior crew members die on away missions at an alarming rate while the officers somehow survive. The crew starts to ask why.
readIf: you like comic science fiction that knows exactly which television clichés it is teasing.
skipIf: you want serious science fiction or characters you will remember deeply.

pairings.reason: The classic of comic science fiction, with a similar love of cosmic absurdity.
Another sarcastic, short, modern science-fiction story that is more focused on a single voice.
A comic fantasy with the same playful, self-aware way of using a familiar story.
